title: Dell Secure Connect Gateway (SCG) Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains a Missing Authentication for…
description: Dell Secure Connect Gateway (SCG) Virtual Edition versions prior to 5.36.00.16 have a Missing Authentication for Critical Function vulnerability. This flaw allows an attacker with local access to potentially disclose sensitive information, modify system resources without authorization, and execute privileged actions that could compromise the appliance.
